_comment: Physical layout registry. Order matches slide order in assets/layouts/template.html. scripts/sync_layouts.py generates NN-slug.html fragments; scripts/deckkit/layouts.py derives their paths from this registry. Register new slugs in layouts.py before syncing. Edit manually only when the template layout set changes.

layouts.name: Title
layouts.structure: Yellow background with pattern, glass panel, logo, .title-large, .subtitle-large, author at bottom
layouts.when: First slide of presentation. Always exactly one

layouts.name: Agenda
layouts.structure: .background-image background, .title-agenda, list of .agenda-number + .agenda-description pairs
layouts.when: Second slide. 3-6 items, more does not fit

layouts.name: One card
layouts.structure: .slide-title, .panel with one .card.gray full width
layouts.when: One idea to expand in detail

layouts.name: Two cards
layouts.structure: .slide-title, .panel with .card.gray and .card.yellow, flex: 1 on both
layouts.when: Contrast or two equal ideas. Yellow for accent

layouts.name: Three cards
layouts.structure: .slide-title, .panel with two .card.gray and one .card.yellow
layouts.when: Three parallel points: stages, directions, criteria

layouts.name: Four cards
layouts.structure: .slide-title, .panel with three .card.gray and one .card.yellow
layouts.when: Four short points in a row. Little text per card

layouts.name: Bullets list
layouts.structure: .slide-title, one .card.yellow with .bullet-list, marker is inline SVG
layouts.when: List where items share common theme. Up to 5 items

layouts.name: Grid 2x2
layouts.structure: .panel as grid, repeat(2, 1fr) for two rows, 4 cards, last is yellow
layouts.when: Four points with descriptions that do not fit in one row

layouts.name: Grid 2x3
layouts.structure: .panel as grid, repeat(3, 1fr) for two rows, 6 cards
layouts.when: Six short points: features, roles, risks

layouts.name: Grid 2x4
layouts.structure: .panel as grid, repeat(4, 1fr) for two rows, 8 cards
layouts.when: Eight points. Density limit: one-line descriptions

layouts.name: Complex
layouts.structure: grid repeat(3, 1fr) for two rows: four cards left, one tall card right via grid-row: span 2
layouts.when: Four equal points and one main point that is more important

layouts.name: Pyramid
layouts.structure: grid repeat(6, 1fr) for two rows: three cards span 2 top, two cards span 3 bottom
layouts.when: Hierarchy or funnel: three specifics top, two conclusions bottom

layouts.name: Metrics, 3 columns
layouts.structure: .background-black, .title-slide, .subtitle-medium, three .metric-value-large with .metric-description
layouts.when: Three key numbers. Main results slide

layouts.name: Metrics, 6 cards
layouts.structure: .background-black, grid repeat(3, 1fr) for two rows, .metric-value-medium
layouts.when: Six numbers at once: summary metrics for period

layouts.name: Final
layouts.structure: Yellow background, glass panel, logo, .title-xlarge
layouts.when: Last slide. Always exactly one

layouts.name: Timeline (3 points)
layouts.structure: .background-timeline (PNG with discs), .slide-title, .timeline-row with 3 .timeline-point (circle + number + connector + text)
layouts.when: Three stages with optional per-point subtitle. Decorative discs on right.

layouts.name: Timeline (4 points)
layouts.structure: .background-light (CSS gradient), .slide-title, .timeline-row with 4 .timeline-point
layouts.when: Four stages or steps in time. No decorative image.

layouts.name: Timeline (5 points)
layouts.structure: .background-light (CSS gradient), .slide-title, .timeline-row with 5 .timeline-point
layouts.when: Five stages or steps in time. No decorative image.

layouts.name: Flow (4 steps)
layouts.structure: .slide-title, .flow-panel (white rounded), .flow-inner centring one .flow-row of 4 .flow-step (icon circle + caption)
layouts.when: Four-step process with icons, no closing block. The captions get the whole panel

layouts.name: Flow (4 steps, with summary)
layouts.structure: Same as flow-4 plus a .flow-summary block along the bottom; the captions are correspondingly shorter
layouts.when: Four-step process that ends on a conclusion

layouts.name: Flow (5 steps)
layouts.structure: .slide-title, .flow-panel, .flow-inner centring one .flow-row of 5 .flow-step
layouts.when: Five-step process with icons, no closing block

layouts.name: Flow (5 steps, with summary)
layouts.structure: Same as flow-5 plus a .flow-summary block along the bottom
layouts.when: Five-step process that ends on a conclusion

layouts.name: Columns dark (3 columns)
layouts.structure: .background-columns (dark gradient), .columns-header (yellow block with title), .columns-panel (white), .columns-row with 3 .columns-col (subtitle + dot + connector + body)
layouts.when: Three detailed points on dark background. Header title in yellow block.

layouts.name: Columns dark (4 columns)
layouts.structure: .background-columns, .columns-header, .columns-panel, .columns-row with 4 .columns-col
layouts.when: Four detailed points on dark background.

layouts.name: Columns dark (5 columns)
layouts.structure: .background-columns, .columns-header, .columns-panel, .columns-row with 5 .columns-col
layouts.when: Five detailed points on dark background.

layouts.name: Columns dark (6 columns)
layouts.structure: .background-columns, .columns-header, .columns-panel, .columns-row with 6 .columns-col
layouts.when: Six detailed points on dark background. Maximum density.

layouts.name: Image
layouts.structure: .title-large, optional .media-note-icon + .media-note-text, .media-panel (white rounded) with a full-bleed .media-image, .media-caption below
layouts.when: One JPEG/PNG the author supplies, with a title and an optional caption

layouts.name: Chart with points
layouts.structure: .background-chart, .title-chart and 1-4 .chart-point rows (selectable icon + text) anchored bottom-left, .chart-plate (white, 1192x960) on the right: .chart-head (chart title + .legend-row), .chart-body (.chart-area with the native chart + .legend-column)
layouts.when: One chart and 1-4 short takeaways beside it. Slides 67-69

layouts.name: Chart with cards
layouts.structure: Dark slide; .chart-plate (1192x960) on the left carrying the slide title, the legend and the chart; three .card.chart-card (583x303) on the right, each a subtitle or a figure plus a description
layouts.when: A chart with three commentary cards, one of which may be a key figure. Slide 64

layouts.name: Two charts
layouts.structure: .background-chart, a large .title-chart-large and an optional .chart-note-row (icon and two lines) across the top, two .chart-plate.compact (888x714) side by side
layouts.when: Two charts to compare. Slide 65 and «Работа с графиками»

layouts.name: Wide chart
layouts.structure: .background-chart, a large .title-chart-large and an optional .chart-note-row (icon and two lines) across the top, one .chart-plate (1844x737, the designers' long slide) the width of the slide below
layouts.when: One chart of a long series - 6 categories or more, twelve months - across the slide. 2.3.0, the designers' review; the title row of slide 65

layouts.name: Statement on glass
layouts.structure: .background-statement-glass (the designers' glass panel over the yellow), .title-large centred on the panel
layouts.when: A statement or a quote; `look: glass` on a statement. 2.4.0, the designers' new dividers

layouts.name: Statement on cards
layouts.structure: .background-statement-cards (two glass cards at a slant), .title-large left-aligned in the lower right card, two lines at most
layouts.when: A short statement; `look: cards` on a statement. 2.4.0, the designers' new dividers

layouts.name: Versus
layouts.structure: two .card.versus-card over the whole slide (yellow left, gray right) with a notch each - clip-path: path() - and .versus-badge between them; .versus-title on top, .versus-bottom (.card-subtitle, .card-description) on the bottom
layouts.when: Contrast of two options, before and after. 2.4.0, the designers' new cards; no icons, no slide title

layouts.name: Chart with points on plates
layouts.structure: chart-points with the plate narrower (927x867) on a stack of two .chart-plate-back behind it
layouts.when: `look: plates` on a chart. 2.4.0, the designers' charts_new

layouts.name: Timeline (4 points, yellow)
layouts.structure: timeline-4 on .background-timeline-yellow (PNG), the title in a text gradient
layouts.when: `look: yellow` on a timeline of 4. 2.4.0, the designers' series

layouts.name: Timeline (5 points, yellow)
layouts.structure: timeline-5 on .background-timeline-yellow (PNG), the title in a text gradient
layouts.when: `look: yellow` on a timeline of 5. 2.4.0, the designers' series

layouts.name: Flow (4 steps, zigzag)
layouts.structure: flow-4 with the captions above and below the icon line in turn
layouts.when: `look: zigzag` on a flow of 4, no summary. 2.4.0, the designers' series

layouts.name: Flow (5 steps, zigzag)
layouts.structure: flow-5 with the captions above and below the icon line in turn
layouts.when: `look: zigzag` on a flow of 5, no summary. 2.4.0, the designers' series

layouts.name: Dense text (draft)
layouts.structure: Yellow panel with native inner glow, two-line headline, measured arrow, bottom-anchored prose in an explicit fit-box
layouts.when: Gate A draft: at most two per deck, separated by other layouts

layouts.name: image-points-plates
layouts.structure: Shared media frame; measured text
layouts.when: Pictures with supporting conclusions

layouts.name: image-points-plate
layouts.structure: Shared media frame; measured text
layouts.when: Pictures with supporting conclusions

layouts.name: image-wide-plate (draft)
layouts.structure: Shared media frame; measured text
layouts.when: Iteration 10 visual gate only

layouts.name: image-wide-plates (draft)
layouts.structure: Shared media frame; measured text
layouts.when: Iteration 10 visual gate only

layouts.name: image-gallery-2
layouts.structure: Shared media frame; measured text
layouts.when: Two or three captioned pictures

layouts.name: image-gallery-3
layouts.structure: Shared media frame; measured text
layouts.when: Two or three captioned pictures

layouts.name: screenshot-phone-1
layouts.structure: Designer device scene with native fitted screen pictures, top-aligned text and optional editable arc annotations
layouts.when: App screens in device frames with optional captions

layouts.name: screenshot-phone-2
layouts.structure: Designer device scene with native fitted screen pictures, top-aligned text and optional editable arc annotations
layouts.when: App screens in device frames with optional captions

layouts.name: screenshot-phone-3
layouts.structure: Designer device scene with native fitted screen pictures, top-aligned text and optional editable arc annotations
layouts.when: App screens in device frames with optional captions

layouts.name: screenshot-monitor
layouts.structure: Designer device scene with native fitted screen pictures, top-aligned text and optional editable arc annotations
layouts.when: Desktop interface with supporting observations

layouts.name: Self introduction
layouts.structure: Speaker name and role, bottom-anchored triangle bullets and a rounded photograph on two translucent plates
layouts.when: Only an explicitly requested speaker introduction

layouts.name: Illustration and points
layouts.structure: Yellow card with the supplied scene on the left, measured titled icon list on the right
layouts.when: Iteration 14 visual gate

layouts.name: Circle with 3 points
layouts.structure: Editable orbit, center title and one or two right cards
layouts.when: Draft circular relationships gate

layouts.name: Circle with 4 points
layouts.structure: Editable orbit, center title and one or two right cards
layouts.when: Draft circular relationships gate

layouts.structure: Editable orbit, center title and one or two right cards
layouts.when: Draft circular relationships gate

layouts.name: Circle with 6 points
layouts.structure: Editable orbit, center title and one or two right cards
layouts.when: Draft circular relationships gate

layouts.name: Table
layouts.structure: .background-light, a .title-chart-large in a fit-box, one .table-card (white) holding a .table-grid[data-table] written as one native a:tbl: a .table-head row and body rows of .table-cell
layouts.when: Figures to read across rows and columns: 2-6 columns, 1-8 rows, on a fixed white card

layouts.name: Table comparison
layouts.structure: A .title-chart-large in a fit-box, a .compare-panel of two .card.compare-card (yellow, grey), each a .card-subtitle over a two-column .table-grid[data-table]
layouts.when: Exactly two tables of label and figure set side by side, each with 2-6 rows
